title: A/R Summary: a PDF of exactly 2,000 customers downloads, 2,001 is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A/R Summary lists exactly 2,000 customers on one date and 2,001 on another, and you export each as a PDF.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • On {Date-A} A/R Summary lists exactly 2,000 customers, and on {Date-B} exactly 2,001.
    For example: a prepared test organization (see the note).
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Set the as-of date to {Date-B}.
  4. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: 2,000 customer rows (the Totals row is not counted).
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads with the "Success" message.
  • Step 3: 2,001 customer rows.
  • Step 4: "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again.": exactly one message and no PDF downloaded (no new file in the browser's downloads).

The row count is the customers listed, not the Totals row. No test site has 2,000 customers with open invoices (the QA organization has 46), so this exact boundary is checked by the developers (SV-11595); the PDF boundary itself is checked by hand on A/P Detail.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • S3-R9: “The row count for the export limits is the number of customer or vendor rows (Summaries) or document rows (the other four), not counting headers, subtotals or the Totals row.”
  • S3-N3: “A refused export shows exactly one message (S3-N1 or S3-N2), never a second generic error.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
